value.referent: AFP surveillance indicator targets (NPAFP rate ≥2 per 100,000 aged <15 years; ≥80% adequate stool specimens) and ES enterovirus isolation target (≥50%)

ev.q: 20 (71.4%) met national AFP surveillance indicator targets
the proportion of sites meeting the enterovirus sensitivity target increased 41%, from 41.7% to 58.8%

changes.why: The only computed contrasts are percent changes (2%, 41%, 134%); year-to-year percentages and counts are otherwise set side by side, so the scale is relative, not both. Referent widened to include the ES target.

equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is analysed; results are by WHO region, country and subnational area, which are geography. Age <15 years only defines the NPAFP rate denominator, and hard-to-reach areas appear only as a limitation about geographic coverage.

ev.q: an NPAFP rate of two or more NPAFP cases per 100,000 persons aged <15 years
